name: Commercial Christmas Trees & Decorations
metaDescription: Giant indoor and outdoor Christmas trees, lobby displays and garland for Ontario and GTA businesses and event spaces. Custom quote, full setup and removal.
heroIntro: Large-scale indoor and outdoor Christmas trees, lit cone trees, garland and lobby displays for businesses, malls and event spaces.
intro: Some commercial properties need more than roofline lighting and a wreath at the door, they need a centrepiece. This service covers exactly that, giant commercial Christmas trees for both indoor lobbies and outdoor plazas, lit cone trees, garland, and full interior decorating for atriums and event spaces. Malls, hotels, office lobbies and municipal squares often build their entire holiday presence around one or two large tree installations rather than lighting spread thin across the whole property.

We handle the full scope, sourcing and setting up the tree itself, wrapping it in lights, adding garland, ornaments and any themed décor the space calls for, and removing everything cleanly once the season ends. Because a large indoor or outdoor tree is often the photo backdrop for the entire season, from customers, employees or event guests, we treat it as the centrepiece it is meant to be rather than a standard install. Every project is custom-quoted based on the size and setting involved.
included: Large-scale indoor or outdoor Christmas trees
Lit cone trees for entrances and plazas
Full tree lighting, ornaments and themed décor
Garland and wreaths to complement the tree installation
Full removal once the season ends

sections.heading: How a tree installation is planned
sections.text: We start by understanding the space, an indoor lobby tree has different height, footprint and access considerations than an outdoor plaza tree exposed to wind and weather. From there we plan tree size, lighting scheme, and any garland or themed décor that ties the centrepiece into the rest of the property's holiday look. For malls, hotels and municipal spaces, we also account for foot traffic and visibility, since these installations are often meant to be seen from a distance and used as a gathering or photo spot through the season.

sections.heading: How pricing works for trees and décor
sections.text: Every tree and décor project is custom-quoted, since a lobby tree for a single office building and a large outdoor plaza centrepiece for a mall require very different scale, materials and setup time. Pricing depends on tree height and quantity, whether it is indoor or outdoor, the amount of garland and themed décor included, and any additional event space decorating requested alongside it. We confirm the full scope and cost after understanding the space and what the finished installation needs to accomplish.

sections.heading: What to expect on setup day
sections.text: Large tree installations typically take more coordination than roofline lighting, so we schedule setup around your property's operating hours and any events already booked in the space. Our crew assembles and secures the tree, wires the lighting fully before adding ornaments or garland, and finishes with any themed décor discussed during planning, checking the finished display against what was agreed on. Once the season wraps up, we return to disassemble and remove everything, leaving the space ready for whatever comes next on your calendar.

pricing: Commercial tree and decoration projects are always custom-quoted, based on tree size, whether it is indoor or outdoor, and how much garland, ornament and themed décor is included. A single lobby tree costs less than a large outdoor plaza centrepiece with full event space decorating. We provide a firm quote once we understand the space and the scale of the installation you have in mind.

faq.q: Do you supply the Christmas tree, or install one we already have?
faq.a: We can source and set up a large-scale tree for your space, or work with a tree your property already owns and simply handle the lighting, ornaments and décor. Let us know which applies when you request a quote so we can plan the lighting and décor scope accordingly, including any garland or themed pieces you would like added.

faq.q: Can you handle both indoor and outdoor tree installations?
faq.a: Yes. Indoor lobby and atrium trees and outdoor plaza trees are both part of this service, though outdoor installations account for wind and weather exposure differently than an indoor setup does, using hardware rated for the elements rather than an indoor finish. We plan for each setting separately during the design stage.

faq.q: Do you decorate for one-time events, not just the full holiday season?
faq.a: Yes, event space decorating is included alongside standard tree and décor work, so a corporate party, gala or single event can get the same tree, garland and themed décor treatment as a season-long lobby display, just set up and struck around your specific event date rather than staying up for the whole season.

faq.q: How long does a large tree installation take to set up and remove?
faq.a: Timing depends on the size and complexity of the tree and décor involved, since a large outdoor plaza centrepiece takes longer than a single lobby tree. We schedule setup and removal around your property's operating hours and any events already booked in the space, and confirm a specific window once the scope is finalized.
